meta_reflection.observation: Filings-first order is adequate in principle for MGNS.L (62/62 bodies; period_coverage annual=10 / interim=3 / trading_update=1) and better than names with no tagged H1: a genuine 23 Jul 2026 HY body exists. It is not adequate in practice: yahoo_quarterly_cashflow sits on the ladder but is empty (TTM suppressed — expected for a UK half-year reporter, not a true hole), alternate_news and ir_presentation_metrics are absent, and the two first-class 2026 operating updates (12 Feb and 16 Apr “Trading and Outlook for 2026”, the latter a profit upgrade that moved the shares ~10%) are period=other with priority 0, ranked below empty quarterlies. Ten ‘annual’ hits include a 19 Jan 2026 Notice of Full Year Results and a 2021 CH interim is still tagged interim. The sole tagged trading_update is the stale 2 Oct 2025 “Outlook for 2025”.

The screen emits strong_buy (16/22, five families including cheapness/quality/GARP/dividend/risk) on a contractor with sub-12% margins (Moat fail), current ratio 1.23, RSI 33 and a price<50<200 downtrend, while cyclical_exposure_detected is false and every overlay is off. FCF bases disagree (£170.7m filing-aligned vs £141.5m screen_ttm) with currency=USD and divergence_flagged false. Quality/Buffett/Piotroski can pass on 26% ROE and “no dilution” while WIP/receivables balloon and Sharesave issuance is continuous. The director–worker loop is being asked to qualitatively veto a mechanically clean headline that sector-cycle, cash-conversion, and FCF-currency overlays failed to brake.

Four worker types plus a five-task cap fit annual+interim+news+screen+gap but consume the entire budget and leave no slot for the 16 Apr 2026 profit-upgrade TU, the 12 Feb TU, the 24 Mar AFR, the 14 May CH group accounts, or the 14 Aug 2026 amended CH accounts. summarize_filing_body cannot carry period=annual|interim|trading_update|amendment, and there is no type to cluster TVR/Sharesave/PDMR RNSs or parse IR slides (news cites “FY 2025 slides”). gap_inventory can only list those holes — it cannot fill them.

weeks_at_signal=1 / stability=new / conviction=0.496 already mark a fresh print, but there is no watch schema for: post-H1 Q3 trading update (typical October for this issuer; catalog fetch 2 Sep has none), FY2026 guidance vs the unread April upgrade, Fit Out concentration, housing/regeneration WIP cash lock-up, remaining Sharesave issuance vs the £4,169.88/£4,001.40 ladder, or the unread August CH amendment.
